items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: They beat up Papa Celeste. That was before he died.

ctx.x: Dance hall. There's a two or three dance hall down there. Now there's a fellow by the name of Freddie Faber. He's a drummer too. Or he's trying to be one of the two. But he broke my drum one night. And of course it didn't amount to much. But the next time I went down there I said, Listen Mr. Freddie, I said, I can't afford to be buying drum heads. I said, You take and let me hold a five dollar bill and you can go ahead and break them. I can buy some more. But I said, Me digging down my pocket, I said, That ain't…
Did they beat up the whole band or just the whole band? The whole band. Well how long ago would that be? After the war?
